from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
import numpy as np

mol = Chem.MolFromMolFile("mol_0174.mol", removeHs=False)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(mol, cleanIt=True, force=True)
print("MMFF params ok:", AllChem.MMFFHasAllMoleculeParams(mol))

AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mol, params)

def signed_vol(m, idx):
    conf = m.GetConformer()
    nbrs = [n.GetIdx() for n in m.GetAtomWithIdx(idx).GetNeighbors()]
    p0 = np.array(conf.GetAtomPosition(idx))
    ps = [np.array(conf.GetAtomPosition(i)) - p0 for i in nbrs]
    return np.dot(np.cross(ps[0], ps[1]), ps[2])

print("vol26 before:", signed_vol(mol, 26))
res = AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(mol, maxIters=5000)
print("MMFF res:", res)
print("vol26 after:", signed_vol(mol, 26))
EOF

content: Found it: the molblock is missing the C5–C6 bond of the ring (the hexagon wasn't closed), and also the wedge bond on the ring's C2→C(=O) is missing. I'll fix both.

args.command:
cat > fix_mol.py << 'EOF'
lines = open("mol_0174.mol").read().splitlines()
# find bond block start
start = 6  # after 3 header lines + counts? header: 3 lines then counts at line 4 (index 3)
# locate counts line
for i, l in enumerate(lines):
    if l.strip().endswith("V2000"):
        counts_idx = i
        break
na, nb = int(lines[counts_idx][0:3]), int(lines[counts_idx][3:6])
bstart = counts_idx + 1 + na
bonds = lines[bstart:bstart+nb]
# fix wedge on bond 6-12 (1-based) -> wedge 1
newb = []
for b in bonds:
    a1, a2, t, s = int(b[0:3]), int(b[3:6]), int(b[6:9]), int(b[9:12])
    if (a1, a2) == (6, 12):
        s = 1
    newb.append("%3d%3d%3d%3d" % (a1, a2, t, s))
# add missing bond 2-10 (1-based) = C5-C6 ring closure
newb.append("%3d%3d%3d%3d" % (2, 10, 1, 0))
nb2 = len(newb)
lines[counts_idx] = "%3d%3d  0  0  0  0  0  0  0  0999 V2000" % (na, nb2)
rest = lines[bstart+nb:]
out = lines[:bstart] + newb + rest
open("mol_0174.mol", "w").write("\n".join(out) + "\n")
print("fixed; bonds now", nb2)
EOF

import numpy as np

def read_xyz(f):

    for l in lines[2:2+n]:

ref = Chem.MolFromMolFile("mol_0174.mol", removeHs=False)

nb = {c: [n.GetIdx() for n in ref.GetAtomWithIdx(c).GetNeighbors()] for c in centers}
for f in ["init3d.xyz", "answer.xyz"]:
    els, xyz = read_xyz(f)
    print(f)
    for c in centers:

        vs = [xyz[i]-p0 for i in nb[c]]

from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem, rdCIPLabeler

def labels(m, from3d=False):
    m = Chem.Mol(m)
    if from3d:
        Chem.AssignStereochemistryFrom3D(m)
    else:
        Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m, cleanIt=True, force=True)
    rdCIPLabeler.AssignCIPLabels(m)
    return {a.GetIdx(): a.GetPropsAsDict().get("_CIPCode","?") for a in m.GetAtoms()
            if a.GetChiralTag() != Chem.ChiralType.CHI_UNSPECIFIED}

mol = Chem.MolFromMolFile("mol_0174.mol", removeHs=False)
target = labels(mol)
print("2D target:", target)
params = AllChem.ETKDGv3(); params.randomSeed = 11
r = AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mol, params)
print("embed", r)
print("MMFF params:", AllChem.MMFFHasAllMoleculeParams(mol))
res = AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(mol, maxIters=10000)
print("MMFF res:", res)
got = labels(mol, from3d=True)
print("3D after MMFF:", got)
print("match:", got == target)
if got == target:
    conf = mol.GetConformer()
    lines = [str(mol.GetNumAtoms()), "mol_0174 3D MMFF-optimized"]
    for a in mol.GetAtoms():
        p = conf.GetAtomPosition(a.GetIdx())
        lines.append("%-3s %12.6f %12.6f %12.6f" % (a.GetSymbol(), p.x, p.y, p.z))
    open("answer.xyz","w").write("\n".join(lines)+"\n")
    print("wrote answer.xyz")
EOF

import numpy as np
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import rdCIPLabeler, rdMolDescriptors, Draw
def read_xyz(f):
    lines = open(f).read().splitlines()
    n = int(lines[0].split()[0])
    els, xyz = [], []
    for l in lines[2:2+n]:
        t = l.split()
        els.append(t[0]); xyz.append([float(t[1]), float(t[2]), float(t[3])])
    return els, np.array(xyz)
els, X = read_xyz("answer.xyz")
# min nonbonded distance & bond sanity via RDKit
ref = Chem.MolFromMolFile("mol_0174.mol", removeHs=False)
m2 = Chem.Mol(ref)
conf = Chem.Conformer(m2.GetNumAtoms())
for i in range(m2.GetNumAtoms()):
    conf.SetAtomPosition(i, X[i].tolist())
m2.RemoveAllConformers(); m2.AddConformer(conf)
Chem.SanitizeMol(m2)
Chem.AssignStereochemistryFrom3D(m2)
rdCIPLabeler.AssignCIPLabels(m2)
got = {a.GetIdx(): a.GetPropsAsDict().get("_CIPCode","?") for a in m2.GetAtoms()
       if a.GetChiralTag() != Chem.ChiralType.CHI_UNSPECIFIED}
print("CIP from 3D:", got)
print("formula:", rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(m2), "charge:", Chem.GetFormalCharge(m2))
print("rings:", [len(r) for r in m2.GetRingInfo().AtomRings()])
# bond length stats
bl = []
for b in m2.GetBonds():
    i, j = b.GetBeginAtomIdx(), b.GetEndAtomIdx()
    bl.append((np.linalg.norm(X[i]-X[j]), els[i], els[j]))
bl.sort()
print("shortest:", ["%.2f %s-%s" % t for t in bl[:3]])
print("longest:", ["%.2f %s-%s" % t for t in bl[-3:]])
# nonbonded min distance
D = np.linalg.norm(X[:,None,:]-X[None,:,:], axis=-1)
n = len(X)
mask = np.ones((n,n), bool)
for b in m2.GetBonds():
    i, j = b.GetBeginAtomIdx(), b.GetEndAtomIdx()
    mask[i,j] = mask[j,i] = False
np.fill_diagonal(mask, False)
# exclude 1-3
for a in m2.GetAtoms():
    nbrs = [x.GetIdx() for x in a.GetNeighbors()]
    for i in nbrs:
        for j in nbrs:
            mask[i,j] = False
idx = np.argwhere(mask & (D < 1.5))
print("nonbonded contacts <1.5A:", len(idx)//2)
Draw.MolToFile(m2, "final_2d.png", size=(600,500))
print("ok")
EOF
